summary: assert options: fail_msg (alias msg) for failures, success_msg, quiet to reduce output, and the required that list of when-style expressions.
questions: How do I set a custom failure message for assert?
How do I show a message when an assertion passes?
How can I make assert less verbose?
What syntax do assert conditions use?

answer_card.title: assert parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `that` (required): list of expressions, same form as `when:`
- `fail_msg` (alias `msg`): message on failure
- `success_msg`: message on success
- `quiet` (false): set `true` to reduce output
